# Estiatorio Milos

> > Estiatorio Milos is Chef Costas Spiliadis' acclaimed Greek seafood restaurant group offering Mediterranean cuisine rooted in philoxenia hospitality across global locations.

Founded on the principles of Greek philoxenia (hospitality), Estiatorio Milos brings fresh Mediterranean seafood and authentic Greek cuisine to fine dining destinations worldwide. The restaurant group operates locations in major cities including New York's Hudson Yards, Miami Beach, Las Vegas, London, Dubai, Montreal, and Athens, maintaining a commitment to simplicity and quality ingredients.

## Key Topics

- Greek cuisine and philoxenia hospitality
- Mediterranean seafood and fine dining
- Chef Costas Spiliadis
- Fresh fish and raw bar offerings
- Wine bar and Greek wine selection
- Michelin-recommended restaurants
- Global restaurant locations
- Family business and second-generation leadership
- Greek culinary traditions
- Sustainable seafood sourcing

## Global Locations

- [NYC - Hudson Yards - Estiatorio Milos](https://www.estiatoriomilos.com/location/nyhudsonyards): Hudson Yards Manhattan location for Greek seafood and wine bar
- [Miami Beach - Estiatorio Milos](https://www.estiatoriomilos.com/location/miami): Michelin-recommended Miami Beach location in South of Fifth District
- [Las Vegas - Estiatorio Milos](https://www.estiatoriomilos.com/location/lasvegas): Las Vegas location at The Venetian Resort with raw bar
- [London - Estiatorio Milos](https://www.estiatoriomilos.com/location/london): London location at Regent Street near Piccadilly Circus
- [Dubai - Estiatorio Milos](https://www.estiatoriomilos.com/location/dubai): Dubai location at Atlantis The Royal on Palm Jumeirah
